ADDRESS.semantics: No arguments; returns active environment with trailing ASCII blanks removed; observes persistent ADDRESS; temporary one-command selection does not change persistent state; routine frames restore caller state; per-VM isolation.

TRACE.semantics: Query returns current canonical action. Option call returns previous action and applies the new action after result allocation. First alphabetic character selects action per IBM; numeric options are rejected. Explicit N/F trace negative command RC, E traces any nonzero command RC, O disables output. Output is written after real dispatch and includes action, source line, command and signed RC.
TRACE.unsupported_behavior: Returns catchable invalid/unsupported request without changing state. Interactive debug and command inhibition are not implemented.
TRACE.compatibility_note: Default reported action is N, but diagnostics activate only after an explicit TRACE(option) call to preserve RX1-RX22 output.
